messages:
Lena (AE): Kicking off MerchantCo POC — they need SSO (SAML), SCIM user sync, RBAC mapping, and domain ownership proof. Also asked for pricing delta between Hosted vs Dedicated. Who can own the preflight checklist?

Priya (SE): I can own SAML + SCIM preflight. Quick q: do they need JIT provisioning or full SCIM sync? Also need expected peak auth RPS and initial object count.

Lena (AE): They said ~5k MAU, peaks around 200 auth/s during batch jobs. SCIM is for employees only (~2k user objects initially). They want both IdP-initiated and SP-initiated SAML flows. Domain proofing via DNS TXT OK.

Luca (Eng Platform): For ~200 auth/s spikes we typically recommend Dedicated or Hosted with routed burst. Dedicated gives predictable latency/SLA; Hosted is fine but could need burst capacity. Pricing ballpark: Dedicated base + throughput addon — I'll send numbers. Note: session affinity + KV cache priming help latency on Dedicated.

Morgan (Security): They also surfaced security/legal asks: SOC2 Type II evidence, EU data residency (eu-west), KMS/BYOK options, SCIM bulk/delta support, SCIM rate limits, group->RBAC attribute mapping, and audit log export. We should confirm which Hosted tiers include BYOK vs Dedicated/Private.

Priya (SE): SCIM endpoints we support: `POST /scim/v2/Users`, `GET /scim/v2/Users?filter=...`, `PUT /scim/v2/Users/{id}`, `PATCH /scim/v2/Users/{id}`. Default rate limit: 60 req/min; offer 500 req/min on Dedicated. Example call: `curl -H 'Authorization: Bearer <TOKEN>' -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/scim/v2/Users -d '{"userName":"jane.doe@merchantco.com"}'`

Lena (AE): @Morgan can you confirm SOC2 + EU region availability and whether BYOK is available for Hosted or only Dedicated/Private? Need a one-pager for MerchantCo legal.

Morgan (Security): Confirmed: SOC2 Type II current in docs. BYOK available in Private and Dedicated (add-on). Hosted can do KMS integration for enterprise with contractual addendum; I'll link the policy and evidence. EU region available for Dedicated/Private; Hosted EU route is possible but requires data routing config. I'll assemble the security checklist and link artifacts.

DevOps Bot: deploy-bot: poc env `merchantco-poc` provisioned in eu-west-1. Initial creds pushed to 1Password path `merchantco/poc` — scheduled 2024-06-05T09:00Z. :rotating_light:

Luca (Eng Platform): I'll draft SAML metadata snippet and RBAC mapping sample. Quick SAML example: ```<EntityDescriptor entityID=\"https://merchantco.idp\">...<AssertionConsumerService Location=\"https://redwood.ai/saml/acs\" />...</EntityDescriptor>```

Luca (Eng Platform): RBAC example: SCIM group `engineering` -> Redwood role `developer`; SCIM group `it-admins` -> role `admin`. We'll provide attribute mapping guidance for Auth0/Okta/OneLogin.

Lena (AE): Action items: Priya — SAML/SCIM config doc + sample metadata by EOD. Luca — pricing sheet + Hosted vs Dedicated latency/throughput comparison by tomorrow. Morgan — security checklist + SOC2 evidence links and KMS/BYOK options. I'll schedule PO kickoff Wed 10am PT and add MerchantCo contacts. Thanks everyone :pray:
